discovery_notes: B392 follow-up 7 of B044 (DLP 2020-2021), 27 web searches. New: Stitch Noel CM LE 3021 and Mickey Sorcier jumbo LE 400 (passiondlp leads promoted); 2020 OE backfill from dein-dlrp: Tower of Terror five, Sword in the Stone three LE 400, Onward two, Lilo & Stitch, Copper & Tod, Bernard & Bianca, rainbow Mickey/Minnie, Halloween 2020 Mickey/Pluto/Donald. BTM OE confirmed by quoted line items. New set Raya OE May 2021 (held). All search_snippet.
